generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open-class decision may confuse an auxiliary classification with the material semantic property being decided, while downstream consumers may support fewer representations than the producer accepts.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use a correlated label or score as proof of a different semantic property, or accept a representation without ensuring the final consumer can use it.
trigger_signals: auxiliary classification used as eligibility proof
material semantic property not represented independently
same value available in structured and free-text forms
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Represent a material semantic decision with independent evidence and hold auxiliary classifications constant while varying that evidence; require consumer parity for every accepted representation.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: For open classes, execute unseen positive and negative members with identical auxiliary signals but opposite material semantic evidence, plus a structural contradiction, and verify producer-to-consumer propagation.
